review_notes: Preserve numbering: examples 1–6; practice restarts at 1 and continues through 15.
Source text and worked solutions include apparent typos/inconsistencies; retained as source, not independently corrected. In particular practice Q12 has differing intermediate and final coordinates.
DOCX contains 537 OLE MathType equations and 103 standalone WMF equations. MTEF structures decoded to native Typst math; WMF duplicates used for cross-checking only.
The theory illustration appears in every variant; the other three source illustrations belong to worked solutions and appear only in dap-an.
